terminals.name: api
terminals.description: Both regional API Workers with remote bindings disabled — Global on http://127.0.0.1:8787, EU on http://127.0.0.1:8788. Check health with `curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8787/health` (expect "ok": true).

terminals.name: seed-fixtures
terminals.command: until curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:8787/health >/dev/null 2>&1; do sleep 1; done; pnpm db:open-authority
terminals.description: Once the Global Worker is healthy, walks the local authority to durable_object_open and seeds the product fixtures (work streams, transcripts, automations) into their Durable Objects. Idempotent; re-runs repair partial imports. Exits when done.
